This scene:
这是古代的故事。孟子小的时候，他的爸爸很早就去世了。从他的家到墓地很近，所以他每天老是从早到晚去墓地跟朋友们玩玩儿。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 这是古代的故事：这是一个古代的故事
- 孟子小的时候：better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 从他的家到墓地很近：他的家离墓地很近
- 所以他每天老是从早到晚去墓地跟朋友们玩玩儿：delete老是；玩儿，V.V. is used to make requests or plans

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 玩玩儿：玩，The reduplicated verb suggests a brief or casual action, which conflicts with an activity lasting from morning to evening. [rule: none]
2. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子小的时候：有一个小男孩叫孟子。他小的时候，This is Mengzi’s first appearance, so introduce him with a full noun phrase before using a pronoun. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
3. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 他每天老是从早到晚去墓地：孟子每天老是从早到晚去墓地，The pronoun could refer to either Mengzi or his father in the previous sentence; repeat the name when another character competes as a possible referent. [rule: ambiguous_reference]

items.reason: “从早到晚”表示长时间活动，动词重叠“玩玩儿”不合适。
孟子首次出现时需要先作较完整的介绍，但改写后的“他小的时候，”仍是未完成的分句。
父亲已经去世，“他”在这里可清楚地指孟子；改后还保留了教师要求删除的“老是”。
